purpose: Private offline Y evidence for a narrow currently-held predicate; not force closure or generic grasp classification.

source_membership.history: Frozen task46/state10 execution-deviation and task46/state13 clean full_repaired block6-to7 native K4 records only; exact source/query/snapshot hashes remain mandatory.
source_membership.old_belief: grasped/lifted/place_ready UNKNOWN cannot be converted to an attribution-caused old TRUE-to-invalid need.
source_membership.held_Y: An independent actual-use or boundary16 state label is possible only under this new certificate; it cannot backfill an earlier prerequisite or deployment X.
source_membership.split: Source task/state/split inherited without movement; same-start pool members remain together. Repeat QC is not a new candidate or label count.

inherited_numeric_gates.actual_complete_role_boundary_gap_noise_: strictly greater than 3*max(target,full_hand same-candidate repeat noise)

new_predeclared_conservative_restriction.complete_target_and_hand: Full uniquely bound target subtree and full hand: gripper root body subtree plus explicitly bound robot mount body's own geoms; palm is mandatory, not two-finger union. Robot-arm contact also recorded and must be absent for the proposed sufficient negative.
new_predeclared_conservative_restriction.collision_vs_visual: Separate collision and visual meshes by complete IDs and declared model roles; preserve all subtree geom metadata. Simulator masks establish annotation scope, not actual-RGB identity or visibility.
new_predeclared_conservative_restriction.complete_actual_silhouette: The whole target and relevant full hand silhouette must be unobstructed and independently observable in the same reliable view across all three frames; a visible finger subset or 16px geometric co-presence is insufficient. No unobserved palm or hidden target part is certified by GT projection alone.
new_predeclared_conservative_restriction.physical_exclusions: Complete contact-ID table proves no target-fullhand or target-any-robot contact; no target robot ancestry, active equality attachment, mocap attachment, or unexplained drive/plugin/external-force dependency. Unsupported or missing constraint data is unknown.
new_predeclared_conservative_restriction.no_new_metric_tuning: No result-selected new physical distance threshold is introduced. Physical min-distance, if collected, remains a diagnostic until a separately approved measurement contract; existing image-gap, registration and original release thresholds are unchanged.
new_predeclared_conservative_restriction.causal_timing: Only frames at or before the declared actual-use deadline may certify that use. Boundary16 recovery cannot satisfy use0 or any earlier use. Cross-block prior carry requires explicit source-identity bridge and continuous hashes, without replacing candidate IDs.
new_predeclared_conservative_restriction.kind: Rigid passive targets only for this sufficient held-negative proposal; articulated whole entities are not lifted/grasped by this contract.

capture_fields_and_sources.full_hand_root: robot.gripper.root_body, robot.robot_model.eef_name, exact sim.model.body_parentid subtree (selected arm explicit for bimanual)
capture_fields_and_sources.geom_table: sim.model geom integer IDs, geom_bodyid, geom_contype/conaffinity/group; robot.gripper.contact_geoms and visual_geoms retained as declared roles; None names never delete an ID
capture_fields_and_sources.contact_pairs: For every i in range(sim.data.ncon): exact geom1/geom2 integer IDs with complete model geom-to-body table
capture_fields_and_sources.constraints: sim.model.neq/eq_type/eq_objtype/eq_obj1id/eq_obj2id/eq_data and CURRENT sim.data.eq_active; model.eq_active0 is not substituted; site equalities resolve model.site_bodyid and joint equalities resolve jnt_bodyid, never treating arbitrary object IDs as bodies
capture_fields_and_sources.structural_attachment: Exact target body parent chain, all robot subtrees, model.body_mocapid, body_jntadr/body_jntnum/jnt_type/jnt_bodyid; unresolved tendon/flex/distance/unknown active constraint types stay unknown. Rigid eligibility must have exactly one freejoint at the bound root and separate frozen task-kind provenance.
capture_fields_and_sources.other_drives: model actuator transmission and joint mapping, nplugin, target data.xfrc_applied/qfrc_applied and model.dof_bodyid; absent fields do not mean no drive
capture_fields_and_sources.visual_evidence: Actual original RGB, full-hand/palm and target role masks/depth, independent causal actual RGB tracking and local registration, all boundaries, same-candidate repeated RGB and centroid noise. Must be added by a separate observer, not fabricated by metadata helper.
capture_fields_and_sources.hashes: Exact source snapshot/action/RGB/proprio and producer/observer source SHA256, same candidate/split/time and repeat-QC hashes; caller verifies actual content, not self-declared flags

labels.held_negative: Only when the new full physical-plus-actual-RGB certificate is complete for three frames; metadata helper never issues this label.
labels.release: Requires earlier certified carrying, subsequent actual opening/contact loss and relative separation under the original measurement gates plus new actual loss/separation observability. Negative held alone is not an event.
labels.placed: Release is not successful placement or correct goal relation. Terminal success cannot prove an earlier release time.
labels.missing: No certificate, carry=None, zero literal finger contact, missing metadata, unknown type, cached frame0, or open request alone never becomes False.

invariants.whole_training_still_requires: All actually active goal/use heads have source-bound before/predicted X, independently certified positives and negatives, exact same-pool/same-time contrasts, split isolation and controls. Metadata counts and replay QC cannot satisfy this gate.
